name: Tinker: Parachute Pack clears its slow-fall on grounded bots (#7926)
contract: Parachute Pack 804690 triggers Parachute 45472 (60 s, 100 ms tick) on party and raid members within 15 yds; its script swaps a falling holder to slow-fall 44795, an infinite aura the core removes only through the landing interrupt that ProcessMovementInfo runs on client fall-land and start-swim packets. Bots never send those packets, so a grounded bot keeps the open canopy forever while the 1 minute buff is long gone. Grouped delivery to bots is intended and stays: the cast must still put 45472 on the bot. set_aura 44795 stands in for the fall-produced buff, which the harness cannot produce without client fall packets; a grounded bot must then lose 44795 through the server-side clearance while a grounded non-bot keeps it, pinning the real-player path unchanged.

steps.label: Parachute Pack still equips a grouped bot with Parachute
Parachute Pack still equips a grouped player with Parachute
A grounded bot loses the infinite slow-fall - fails before the fix, when the open canopy stays
A grounded player keeps the slow-fall for its client landing packet
